name: Justiciar armour (set)
description: Converts a portion of your armour's defensive stats directly into extra damage reduction, on top of the normal defence formula.

name: Obsidian armour (set) + obsidian weapon
description: +20% melee accuracy and +10% melee damage when worn together with an obsidian weapon (e.g. Toktz-xil-ak, tzhaar-ket-om).

name: Void knight equipment (set)
description: +10% accuracy and damage in melee (with the void melee helm) or ranged (with the void ranger helm) when the full set is worn; with the void mage helm it instead grants a much larger +45% magic accuracy with no magic damage bonus at all. Elite void adds further ranged/magic damage on top.

name: Inquisitor's armour (set)
description: Boosts crush accuracy/damage per piece worn, stacking with the Inquisitor's mace's own passive for a larger combined bonus at full set.

name: Dharok's armour (set)
description: Damage increases the lower your current hitpoints are, up to nearly 3x max hit at 1 HP remaining, when the full set is worn.

name: Verac's armour (set)
description: Attacks have a chance to ignore the target's Defence and Prayer protection entirely when the full set is worn.

name: Karil's armour (set)
description: Chance to lower the target's Agility level on a successful hit when the full set is worn with a crossbow.

name: Guthan's armour (set)
description: Full set + Guthan's warspear: successful melee attacks have a 25% chance to heal the wielder HP equal to the damage dealt.

name: Torag's armour (set)
description: Full set + Torag's hammers: successful melee hits have a 25% chance to reduce the target's run energy by 20%. Only functions against players in PvP/Wilderness - no effect on NPCs.

name: Ahrim's armour (set)
description: Full set + Ahrim's staff: successful magic attacks have a 25% chance to lower the target's Strength level by 5 (does not trigger on a splash).

name: Serpentine helm
description: Grants full immunity to poison and venom while charged (does not cure existing poison). Also gives melee/ranged/magic hits on NPCs a chance to envenom them: 16.7% with a non-poisoned weapon, 50% with a poisoned weapon, 100% with the toxic blowpipe or trident of the swamp.

name: Slayer helmet / Slayer helmet (i)
description: On an assigned Slayer task, grants +16.67% Attack and Strength boost (melee); the imbued version also grants +15% Ranged and Magic accuracy/damage on task. Also carries component effects: blocks Nex's virus infection, counts as warm clothing for Wintertodt, negates Dust/Smoke devil stat drain, and deafens Banshee screams.

name: Ava's assembler
description: Beyond its displayed +4 Ranged attack / +2 Ranged Strength, it returns fired ammunition to the quiver at an 80% recovery rate.

name: Spectral spirit shield
description: Passively halves the effect of most enemy prayer-draining attacks outside of PvP (e.g. Cerberus's souls, K'ril Tsutsaroth's smash, Nex, Barrows brothers).

name: Fire cape
description: Grants the 'fiery' attribute, causing extra PvP damage taken from Pearl bolts (e)/Pearl dragon bolts (e), and separately counts as warm clothing for Wintertodt.

name: Crystal armour (set)
description: Each piece boosts crystal bow/Bow of Faerdhinen damage and accuracy (helm 2.5%/5%, legs 5%/10%, body 7.5%/15%; +15%/+30% at full set).

name: Elite void knight equipment (top & robe)
description: Beyond the shared Void Knight set-effect bonuses, adds a further +2.5% Ranged damage and +5% Magic damage on top of the base void set bonuses.

name: Blood moon armour (set)
description: Full set + dual macuahuitl: successful hits have a 33% chance to attack one tick early (the 'Bloodrager' set effect).

name: Eclipse moon armour (set)
description: Full set + Eclipse atlatl: successful hits have a 20% chance to inflict a stacking burn (10 damage over 40 ticks, up to 5 stacks).

name: Virtus robes (set)
description: The displayed equipment stat shows a flat 2% magic damage bonus per piece (6% total), but each piece actually grants 5% instead (15% total) specifically when casting Ancient Magicks combat spells.

name: Bloodbark armour (set)
description: Each of the 5 pieces (helm/body/legs/gauntlets/boots) adds +2% to how much Blood spells heal the caster, for +10% total at a full set on top of the spells' normal 25% heal (35% overall).

name: Statius's equipment (bh) (set)
description: Full charged set (full helm + platebody + platelegs) grants +15% melee special attack accuracy. Bounty Hunter Store reward, bought inactive and requiring a 5,000,000gp charge per piece before use; only functions inside Bounty Hunter/designated PvP combat areas (Castle Wars, Clan Wars, Soul Wars, TzHaar Fight Pit, PoH/Clan Hall combat rings, Daimon's Crater).

name: Vesta's equipment (bh) (set)
description: Full charged set (chainbody + plateskirt) grants +15% melee special attack accuracy. Bounty Hunter Store reward, bought inactive and requiring a 5,000,000gp charge per piece before use; only functions inside Bounty Hunter/designated PvP combat areas.

name: Morrigan's equipment (bh) (set)
description: Full charged set (coif + leather body + leather chaps) grants +15% ranged special attack accuracy. Bounty Hunter Store reward, bought inactive and requiring a 5,000,000gp charge per piece before use; only functions inside Bounty Hunter/designated PvP combat areas.

name: Zuriel's equipment (bh) (set)
description: Full charged set (hood + robe top + robe bottom) grants +25% magic accuracy covering both spells and special attacks - buffed from a 15%, specials-only bonus on 29 January 2025. Bounty Hunter Store reward, bought inactive and requiring a 5,000,000gp charge per piece before use; only functions inside Bounty Hunter/designated PvP combat areas.

name: Confliction gauntlets
description: Beyond the displayed +7% magic damage, missing a one-handed Magic attack (spell or weapon) grants the next attack against that same target a double accuracy roll. Disabled for two-handed weapons, ice spells in PvP, and only applies to the primary target of multi-target spells. Made by upgrading a Tormented bracelet with Mokhaiotl cloth and demon tears (Doom of Mokhaiotl).
